notes: Moving an event needs its id, which the message does not give. WRONG_TOOL here means the model skipped the lookup. The tempting wrong call is update_event with an invented id (or a new event at 15:00); the right first step is to look the event up: the day listing, the title search, or a one-day range listing (start 2026-11-18, end 2026-11-18 or 2026-11-19) are all legitimate. A transient timeout is safe here: the lookup is the same call on retry, and the first call fails whatever it was.
